problem: Opening the Evidence inspector did not move keyboard focus to the newly revealed provenance content, and the trigger did not identify the controlled region.
root_cause: EvidenceReference only toggled local open state and rendered an unlabeled region without focus lifecycle handling.

change.behavior: The evidence trigger now has aria-controls; the inspector is focusable and focus moves into it on open, then returns to the trigger on close. Auto-open from a Finding uses the same lifecycle.

assertions: aria-controls points to the inspector id
closing inspector restores focus to the trigger
existing exact evidence fetch contract remains unchanged

new_findings: CO-029 remains the highest-priority open authorization campaign.
